title: Specifying Fixed No-smoking Radius around Playgrounds
what_it_is: Specifying Fixed No-smoking Radius around Playgrounds

sections.label: Smoking ban at playgrounds
sections.summary: Smoking has been prohibited at publicly accessible playgrounds and adjacent amenities since 2009, and the Ministry will review the regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Under the Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Regulations, smoking has been prohibited at all publicly accessible playgrounds since 2009.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Smoking at amenities adjacent to playgrounds such as chairs, benches and sidewalks that are for users of the playground and their caregivers, is also prohibited.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This serves as a buffer area to protect the playground users from second-hand tobacco smoke.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: My Ministry will review the smoking prohibition regulations from time to time.

sections.label: Low smoking-related feedback
sections.summary: Feedback or complaints on smoking related to such facilities is very low, less than 1%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The number of feedback or complaints on smoking related to such facilities is actually very low, less than 1%.

sections.label: Localised solutions for smoking areas
sections.summary: Localised solutions with community and agencies can address design and location concerns, such as more signs or moving a dustbin in Senja.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we do is, there will be some cases where there could be concerns, as the Member rightly pointed out, in terms of design and location of the facilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And I think for such instances, localised solutions could be worked out, together with the community, the agencies, the stakeholders involved, in order to, say, put up more signs to ensure that people are aware of where this smoking prohibited area is.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the case of Senja, I understand that there is a new playground, for instance, where the issue is of a dustbin, which is right next to the smoking prohibited area.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And I think the Town Council is going to move this further away.
